decisions.reason: The carpentry workshop still fits the firm's vocational, therapeutic, and sheltered-work capabilities, but its commercial custom-furniture element keeps the withdrawal risk at a moderate level.
Counseling for senior living is highly aligned with the core eldercare business and likely supports referrals into other services, so its discontinuation risk remains low.
The retail shop continues to support sheltered-work participation and sales of workshop output, but as a peripheral retail channel it remains the most vulnerable if resources are tightened.

Meal delivery for seniors fits the firm's everyday-life support offer and growing home-based care demand, though its operational logistics make it somewhat less secure than core advisory and care services.
